scorecard.rationale: The 2023 abstract favors refined sesame oil against refined sunflower oil on fatigue during weight loss. The exact test for p=.002, arm estimates and a cold-pressed or oil-free contrast remain unavailable. The companion reports corroborate the trial lineage without adding a fatigue analysis. Eight of thirteen in an uncontrolled Parkinson cannabidiol trial reported fatigue while taking a sesame-oil carrier. The indirect active-oil human comparison retains a minimal easing lean.
